title: Towards Faithful Data Selection: Statistical Limits and Scalable Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.30442v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What does it mean to have an optimal data selection algorithm? Optimality is conventionally framed as finding a subset that minimizes the population error of the classifier trained only on that subset. Our starting point in this work is first to show that this goal is information-theoretically impossible unless the data selection algorithm has access to a validation set order-wise larger than the training set. This impossibility result motivates shifting from unverifiable population risk minimization to a one-sided guarantee that we refer to as faithfulness: for any candidate subset, we provide an estimable proxy that upper-bounds the difference between training on the full training data and on only the subset. We model training with the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm and bound the Kullback--Leibler divergence between subset-trained and full-data-trained parameter distributions by the trajectory-accumulated gradient discrepancy. Minimizin

translated_title: 迈向忠实的数据选择：统计极限与可扩展算法
translated_abstract: 什么才是最优的数据选择算法？传统上，最优性被定义为找到一个子集，使得仅在该子集上训练的分类器的总体误差最小化。本工作的出发点是首先证明，除非数据选择算法能够访问比训练集数量级更大的验证集，否则这一目标在信息论上是不可能实现的。这一不可能性结果促使我们从无法验证的总体风险最小化转向一种单边保证，我们称之为“忠实性”：对于任何候选子集，我们提供一个可估计的代理量，该代理量给出在全量训练数据上训练与仅在子集上训练之间差异的上界。我们使用未调整朗之万算法对训练过程进行建模，并通过轨迹累积梯度差异来约束子集训练与全量数据训练所得参数分布之间的Kullback--Leibler散度。通过最小化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了在缺乏远大于训练集的验证集时实现最优数据选择在信息论上是不可能的，并据此提出“忠实性”这一新目标，通过可估计的代理量上界子集训练与全量训练的差异，并利用未调整朗之万算法和轨迹累积梯度差异对参数分布的KL散度进行约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that optimal data selection is information-theoretically impossible without a validation set order-wise larger than the training set, and introduces a "faithfulness" guarantee—an estimable proxy upper-bounding the gap between training on a subset versus the full data—modeled via the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm with KL divergence bounded by trajectory-accumulated gradient discrepancy.
